source.background_method: median in 55–78 pixel annulus about crop centre
source.resampling: exact rectangular pixel-area overlap; integrated pixel flux; original image-axis orientation retained
source.quality: finite SCI values and positive WHT across crop; calibrated archive product; no independent photometric recalibration
source.interpretation: Observed morphology template. Original HST PSF and noise retained. No deconvolution, component fitting, separation scaling or K-band photometry.
source.model: One spatially invariant on-axis 2.2 micrometre simulation PSF applied across this compact source. Illustrative extra blurring of an F775W observation.
source.credit: NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope; ACS/HRC program 9451; calibrated data retrieved from MAST (STScI).

rendering.wavefront: piston removed; 4×4 valid-pupil average; fixed common symmetric range covering all display maps
rendering.PSF: fixed log scale, 1e-6 to 1 of ideal peak; full-grid flux normalization retained
rendering.binary: fixed shared asinh mapping, softening = source peak/100; signed values retained numerically; display clips negative to black
rendering.orientation: source image axes preserved; positive model y displayed upwards; no sky-orientation claim for simulated pupil
